# wheelos_core

> Bazel-first Cyber RT middleware for C++17 autonomous systems.

## Canonical documentation

- [Repository README](README.md): build, test, packaging, and integration overview.
- [Documentation index](docs/doxy-docs/source/index.md): user and developer guides.
- [Installation and usage](docs/doxy-docs/source/Wheelos_Core_Installation_and_Usage.md): Bzlmod, runtime bundle, and Python wheel boundaries.
- [Component tutorial](docs/doxy-docs/source/CyberRT_Quick_Start.md): component, DAG, BUILD, and launch workflow.
- [C++ API tutorial](docs/doxy-docs/source/CyberRT_API_for_Developers.md): nodes, pub/sub, services, parameters, timers, and records.
- [Python API](docs/doxy-docs/source/CyberRT_Python_API.md): Python bindings and examples.
- [Developer tools](docs/doxy-docs/source/CyberRT_Developer_Tools.md): monitor, recorder, and supported runtime commands.
- [Scheduling and deployment](docs/doxy-docs/source/CyberRT_Scheduling_Deployment.md): coroutine scheduling, CPU placement, IRQs, and shared memory.
- [Release baseline](docs/doxy-docs/source/WheelOS_Core_Baseline.md): repository validation gates.
- [Generated C++ API](docs/doxy-docs/source/api/cppapi_index.rst): Doxygen reference.
- [Generated Python API](docs/doxy-docs/source/api/pythonapi_index.rst): Doxygen reference.
- [C++ component example](examples/common_component_example/README.md): build and
  run a shared-library component.
- [Python package example](packaging/pycyber/README.md): build and run a Bazel
  `pycyber` application.

## Build entry points

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh
bazel build //cyber
bazel test //cyber/message/...
bash scripts/release/build_release_artifacts.sh
```

## Documentation build

Read the Docs uses `.readthedocs.yaml` and builds the Sphinx project in
`docs/doxy-docs/source`. The project combines Markdown guides with generated
Doxygen API pages.
